summary: End-to-end testing of Super Admin user-level impersonation (GO) on tenant demo-logitrak. Backend pytest suite backend/tests/test_impersonation.py = 14/14 PASS. UI + E2E token flows for admin / read_only / driver / manager targets all PASS. Negative API (cross-tenant 404, disabled 409, non-SA 403, end without session 400) all PASS. Module OFF (fines) stays OFF during impersonation (nav-fines hidden, GET /api/fines -> 403 MODULE_DISABLED). Audit (audit_logs impersonation_start + impersonation_end with superadmin_id, target_user_id, target_role, session_id, created_at, duration_s) and impersonation_sessions.ended_at verified in MongoDB. Session end revokes impersonation token (401) while superadmin token still works (200). Regression: demo admin direct login shows no banner and label 'Gestion administrative de flotte'; /admin shows demo-logitrak Modules 10/10 badge; /admin/outils renders admin-tools-page. All demo-logitrak modules restored to 10/10. Manager created with prefix pytest- was disabled (not deleted) and no longer appears in dialog.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py remains very large (>8700 lines) — impersonation routes could live in a dedicated router for maintainability.

ImpersonateDialog user rows carry data-testid but a brief render delay after dialog open means immediate locator().count() can be 0 while click still works; non-blocking, but adding a visible-wait on impersonate-user-list before interactive assertions would make test flakes less likely.
test_credentials: SUPERADMIN_EMAIL/SUPERADMIN_PASSWORD from backend/.env; admin@demo-logitrak.ch / DemoPreview2026!, driver@demo-logitrak.ch, readonly@demo-logitrak.ch per /app/memory/test_credentials.md §6.
seed_data_creation: Created one temporary manager user pytest-mgr-<rand>@demo-logitrak.ch on demo-logitrak with vehicle_scope = [first vehicle]. User was disabled (disabled: true) at end of testing (not deleted, as instructed). No password changes made. All demo-logitrak modules remain 10/10 ON.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Impersonation feature is fully green: dialog (impersonate-dialog, impersonate-user-<email>, impersonate-user-scope-<email>, impersonate-confirm-btn), banner (impersonation-banner, impersonation-user, impersonation-role, impersonation-exit-btn), layout-module-label 'Mode assistance', user-menu-btn hides change-password + shows 'Quitter le compte'. Token storage: lt_token = impersonation token during assist; lt_sa_token = SA restore token. Backend returns 403 payloads nested under detail (e.g. {'detail':{'code':'MODULE_DISABLED',...}} or {'detail':{'code':'DRIVER_FORBIDDEN',...}}). Impersonation end revokes impersonation JWT (401 after) while SA JWT remains valid. Audit action labels used: 'impersonation_start' and 'impersonation_end' with ended_at on impersonation_sessions.
